Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using a FLAG-tagged bait (praja2RM) to identify interactors. Quantification is performed by comparing the bait sample to an empty vector control (LFQ approach).

scope: we performed a proteomic analysis of affinity-purified praja2 complexes from total cell lysates
HEK293 cell lysates overexpressing FLAG-praja2 inactive mutant RM or FLAG-Empty Vector (EV) were subjected to immunoprecipitation
Lysates were immunoprecipitated with anti-Flag M2 affinity gel (Merck, # A2220) for 3 h
Both immunopurified protein samples were analyzed by 10% T SDS-PAGE and stained with colloidal Coomassie blue
